held.headline: Bitcoin ETFs Draw $134 Million as Jobs Report Shifts Fed Rate Outlook
held.why: rests on one secondary outlet, so it is not the day's story
held.key_fact: Spot Bitcoin ETFs drew $102.7 million on October 2 and $31.7 million on October 3 after jobs data cooled Fed rate expectations from 70% to 14% odds of an October hike.
